segmentName: Moneris Day End Batch Balance (Response) Segment
scope: Segment 140 field-level rules: reiteration of request fields plus Moneris debit/credit/correction totals

rules.title: Segment 140 consists of a reiteration of the first 6 fields in the Segment 139 request, followed by a text response from Moneris, followed by the total of all debit transactions for this batch

Segment Type fixed 140, Segment Length 3 digits, both Device-sourced; fields 3 (Terminal Identifier), 5 (Moneris Terminal Identifier), 6 (Moneris Merchant ID) are Device-sourced echoes, while fields 4 (SPDH Header), 7 (Batch Number), 8-14 (Response Display, Number/Dollar totals) are Moneris-sourced
rules.note: 14 fields total — the richest field count of any segment trained in this batch. Field-level sourcing genuinely alternates between Device (echo) and Moneris (new data); do not assume uniform sourcing.

rules.title: Debit Dollar Value (218), Credit Dollar Value (220), and Corrections Dollar Value (222) use format +/-9(16)v99 (signed, up to 16 integer digits, 2 implied decimal digits)
